normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is only consumed by the mint loop and payment check and has no standalone semantics
The baseURI parameter only exists to update _baseTokenURI inside setBaseURI
The id parameter is derived from the token tracker and only used inside mintGoblin
The id parameter is only a lookup key for the goldCoins mapping access
The person parameter only drives the enumeration loop inside goldBalance
The local balance snapshot only feeds the payout arithmetic in withdraw
randomNumber is the direct output of the insecure on-chain randomness computation
randomCoins is derived from the weak randomness result and assigned to token state
The total accumulator only exists inside the goldBalance view loop
The loop index i only exists inside the goldBalance view loop
